title: Stability-Aware Feature Design for Robust Watermark Detection in Machine-Generated Text
abstract: arXiv:2608.18102v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The widespread adoption of large language models (LLMs) has intensified the demand for principled methods to distinguish human from machine-generated text. Watermarking provides a promising avenue, yet existing detectors exhibit sharp performance deterioration under multiple paraphrasing and when applied to shorter texts. We introduce Pattern Stability Score (PSS), a novel detection framework that leverages local statistical features and stability dynamics across paraphrased variants. Specifically, the proposed method combines global and local z-score features with higher-order statistics of run-length patterns, enriched by autocorrelation signals and stability scores computed over paraphrase depth. translated_title: 面向机器生成文本稳健水印检测的稳定性感知特征设计
translated_abstract: 摘要：大语言模型（LLMs）的广泛采用加剧了对区分人类与机器生成文本的原则性方法的需求。水印技术提供了一种有前景的途径，但现有检测器在多次改写及应用于较短文本时表现出显著的性能退化。我们引入了模式稳定性分数（PSS），一种利用局部统计特征和跨改写变体的稳定性动态的新型检测框架。具体来说，所提出的方法结合了全局和局部z-score特征与游程模式的高阶统计量，并通过自相关信号和基于改写深度计算的稳定性分数进行增强。数值评估在三个基准数据集（PG-19、CNN/DailyMail和WikiText）上进行，使用多种LLMs（Llama-3-8B、Qwen2-7B）和改写器（Mistral-7B、Qwen2-7B、Gemma-7B），系统性地压力测试了在改写条件下的鲁棒性。
tldr: 提出了一种基于模式稳定性分数（PSS）的检测框架，通过结合局部统计特征和跨改写变体的稳定性动态，显著提升了机器生成文本水印检测在改写和短文本场景下的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: A novel detection framework based on Pattern Stability Score (PSS) is proposed, which enhances robustness of machine-generated text watermark detection under paraphrasing and short-text scenarios by integrating local statistical features and stability dynamics across variants.
